def mean(vals):
    return sum(vals) / len(vals)

def std(vals):
    m = mean(vals)
    return math.sqrt(sum((x - m)**2 for x in vals) / (len(vals) - 1))

# --- Qwen ---
qr = qwen["runs"]

# Per-seed best R@1
qwen_random = {
    "s42": qr["random_s42"]["best_by_R@1"]["R@1"],

}
qwen_embed = {
    "s42": None,
    "s43": qr["embedding_distance_s43"]["best_by_R@1"]["R@1"],
    "s44": qr["embedding_distance_s44"]["best_by_R@1"]["R@1"],
}

qwen_embed_vals = [v for v in qwen_embed.values() if v is not None]

s44_delta = qwen_embed["s44"] - qwen_random["s44"]
